## About me
"As a reporter, I learned that good decisions start with good questions. San Mateo deserves leaders who listen carefully, examine issues from every angle and communicate honestly about the choices facing our city."
Learn more
## Let's write San Mateo's Future Together!
Support the Campaign
Donate
## Community Priorities
###### Economic Accountability
Protect services. Demand transparency. Plan responsibly.
###### Public Safety
Safe neighborhoods start with strong police and fire staffing
###### Infrastructure and Transportation
Fix local infrastructure before small problems become expensive ones
###### Responsible Housing and Growth
Responsible growth should strengthen our neighborhoods, not overwhelm them
###### A RESPONSIVE GOVERNMENT
A more efficient City Hall
###### strongly supporting
